newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms Canada's AA+ forex credit rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Canada's AA+ forex credit rating.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Tuesday it had affirmed the Canadian government's AA+ long-term foreign currency credit rating and revised its outlook to stable from negative.

S&P also affirmed Canada's AAA long-term local-currency credit rating as well as its A-1 plus short-term rating. The outlook for Canada's long-term local currency rating remained stable, S&P said in a statement.

The change in the foreign currency rating reflected the improvement in the government's fiscal and balance-of-payment positions as federal and provincial fiscal deficits continue to narrow, the statement said.
